subject: general
question: Two pipes X and Y can fill a tank in 12 minutes and 18 minutes, respectively. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, how long will it take to fill the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Time(X) = 12minutes

Time(Y) = 18 minutes

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = 1/ Time

**Solution:**

1/ Time(X + Y) = 1/12 + 1/18 

1/Time(X + Y) = 5/36

Time(X + Y) = 36/5 = 7(1)/(5) minutes.

**Hence, If both pipes are opened simultaneously, it will take 7(1)/(5) minutes to fill the tank.**
